about: Mutants of hosts/opentui (the schema of hosts/mygo's ledger). Each edit is applied to a copy of the module's file, then the killers run. A killer is dir:Test, where dir is a directory of this Go module (hosts/opentui/<pkg>).

mutants.name: OT0-fetch-no-integrity
mutants.from: if err := CheckIntegrity(data, want); err != nil {
mutants.to: if err := CheckIntegrity(data, want); false && err != nil {
mutants.rule: a tarball whose bytes differ from the pinned sha512 integrity is refused before it is read

mutants.name: OT0-no-struct-size
mutants.rule: every record carries its struct_size (bindc's autofill); OpenTUI refuses one without

mutants.name: OT0-any-abi
mutants.rule: Load refuses a library of another ABI version; the check is generated, so a hand edit is refused

mutants.name: OT1-destroy-leaves-children
mutants.rule: Destroy removes the whole subtree, children first, so no handle of it stays

mutants.name: OT1-move-ignores-index
mutants.rule: Move puts the node at its index among the parent's children

mutants.name: OT1-chunk-drops-escape
mutants.rule: an escape sequence cut between two feeds is one key, not Escape and text

mutants.name: OT1-resize-not-passed
mutants.rule: Resize resizes the renderer, so the scene lays out at the new size

mutants.name: OT1-off-owner-thread
mutants.rule: every library call runs on the owner thread

mutants.name: OT1-close-no-drain
mutants.rule: Close writes the terminal's restoration before it frees the session
